text:
maria: quick RFC follow-up — cp epoch sync + ephemeral endpoint aging. we had a customer cutover where private endpoints stayed 'healthy' for ~12h after the control plane moved, which caused traffic to land on stale dataplanes. looking for short-term mitigations and a long-term contract change.

kevin: ugh. saw that in the logs. looks like the agent didn't pick up the new epoch header, kept serving cached route table. i think we need an explicit `epoch` in the controlplane handshake and make agents treat epoch mismatch as catalog-change, not a soft refresh. :eyes:

jamie: agree. two quick options: 1) bump epoch -> agents drop connections immediately and re-resolve; 2) add TTL on ephemeral endpoints so they auto-expire if they don't see a heartbeat. option 1 is more immediate but more disruptive. option 2 is safer for live traffic.

tara: can we combine? epoch bump + phased grace-period to avoid thundering herd. e.g. epoch X -> agents start a 30s drain window, then force swap if still bound to old dataplane. we should also publish a per-tenant `ephemeral_grace` config in the controlplane.

kevin: prototype sketch:```json
{
  "epoch": 42,
  "ephemeral_grace_s": 30,
  "force_swap_after_s": 120
}
```agents will: on epoch diff -> mark route STALE, start drain timer = ephemeral_grace_s, after force_swap_after_s do immediate reconnect.

maria: + add observability: a counter `cp.epoch_mismatch` and a histogram `ephemeral_age_seconds`. need dashboards + alert when mismatch rate > 0.5% per minute for >5min.

deploy-bot: alert: private-endpoint-drift triggered — 2025-06-12 14:08 UTC — 0.8% mismatches in last 5m. (link: https://console/redwood/alerts/pe-drift-332)

jamie: for rollout: we can default ephemeral_grace to 60s and set a feature-flag per region. do a canary on low-traffic tenants first. also add client-side jitter on reconnect to spread load.

tara: ops playbook draft: 1) on epoch bump, watch `cp.epoch_mismatch` 2) if > 1% -> pause rollout and run `kubectl exec -n agent -c agent -- /usr/local/bin/agent-health --flush-ephemeral` 3) if still noisy, revert epoch and open incident. I'll add exact commands to the runbook.

maria: nice. action items: kevin — PR for handshake + config (small protobuf change). jamie — telemetry + dashboard. tara — runbook + canary plan. i'll coordinate the rollout and timebox a quick spike this week. thanks. :thumbsup:

kevin: working on the handshake PR, will ping when ready for review.

jamie: starting dashboard panels now.

maria: cool — we'll sync in tomorrow's arch checkin.
